summary: Listed as a tower in Pender County, NC, on the tnlandforms.us list with coordinates and code EA2521; no other source read describes it.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms entry for Top Sail (Barlowes), Pender County, with coordinates and code

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list names this tower. Checked: NHLR and firetower.org North Carolina indexes (no match), two web searches, Topsail Township Wikipedia (no tower or Barlow mention), NCpedia gazetteer B pages 22 and 23 (no Barlowes entry in the cached text). A Bannerman Fire Tower in Pender County (TopoQuest, 19 ft, seen in search results, not read) is a different record (tnlandforms NCT007, 34.59166,-77.80027) and is not used. The Topsail Island concrete towers are missile-test observation towers, not lookouts, and are not used. The story is under the 120-word floor because the evidence is one list entry; the editor may hold it or add a source.
